name: Waterloo / Hamilton
description: A Waterloo–Kitchener–Guelph–Hamilton connection with a later seasonal Burlington branch.

timeline.event: The launch timetable took effect, with weekday service beginning the following Monday.
The new hourly weekday Waterloo–Hamilton route began.
Seasonal weekend branch 17B began Waterloo–Burlington service for Niagara connections; its announced season ended 24 August.

sources.title: GO Waterloo / Hamilton table 17, effective 8 April 2023; weekday service began 10 April

gaps: Summer 17B may be absent from autumn GTFS snapshots.
Any later seasonal revival requires independent dates.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
